examples:
A monkey and polar bear host a casual podcast about AI inference, bringing their unique perspectives from different environments (tropical vs. arctic) to discuss how AI systems make decisions and process information.
Sample Dialogue:
Monkey (Banana): "Welcome back to Bananas & Ice! I am Banana"
Polar Bear (Ice): "And I'm Ice!"

pricingText:
For every second of video you generate you will be charged **$0.10** without audio or **$0.15** with audio for 720p or 1080p. At 4k, you will be charged **$0.30** per second without audio, or **$0.35** with. For example, a **5 second video** at **1080p** with **audio on** will cost **$0.75**.

For more details, see [fal.ai pricing](https://fal.ai/pricing).
